name: How do luxury home agents market properties differently than standard homes?

mainEntity.name: How do luxury home agents market properties differently than standard homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Luxury home marketing emphasizes exclusive channels and high-quality presentation. This includes professional photography, videography, drone footage, and 3D virtual tours. Marketing often extends beyond local MLS listings to include international luxury real estate portals, targeted digital campaigns, and exclusive networking events. Agents like those at Realty ONE Group Evolution leverage their extensive network across Aventura, Boca Raton, Coral Gables, and other prime South Florida locations to reach discerning buyers.
acceptedAnswer.description: Luxury homes are marketed with high-quality visuals, virtual tours, and advertised on international portals and exclusive networks to reach affluent buyers.
